items.title: Benchmarking the Gemini Decisions API
items.summary: The Gemini Decisions API scores a fixed set of answers in one pass and returns probabilities. An ADK triage agent built on it, a 48-ticket benchmark against Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and Gemma 4 E2B, and a test of 1 to 100 questions in one request.
